title: Google Antigravity adapter (App, IDE, agy CLI)
description: Always-on global rule ~/.gemini/config/rules/llm-config-core.md that includes ~/.agents/CORE.md natively, skills copied to both Antigravity skill folders, five subagents in ~/.gemini/config/agents. Leaves ~/.gemini/GEMINI.md to the Gemini CLI adapter.
postInstall: Antigravity: the core rules load through the always_on rule ~/.gemini/config/rules/llm-config-core.md, which the App, IDE and agy CLI all read; Antigravity expands its @[Core rules](~/.agents/CORE.md) include. ~/.gemini/GEMINI.md is left to the Gemini CLI adapter; Antigravity reads that file too, and the rule tells the agent not to load CORE.md twice. Skills are copied to ~/.gemini/config/skills and ~/.gemini/antigravity-cli/skills because Antigravity does not document ~/.agents/skills. Subagents use only documented tool names (view_file, grep_search, replace_file_content, run_command); no web tool name or read-only flag is documented, so evidence-overseer has no web access and read-only roles rely on their instructions. Check them in a new session; a wrong tool name can make a subagent hang. No hooks are installed; see components/antigravity/HOOKS.md.
